claims.claim: Canonical Principal identity is independent of model/provider/session/engine identifiers.
No Principal is ACTIVE without World 8 Entity backing and PrincipalContract.
WorkOrder text alone cannot create effect authority.
Delegated authority cannot widen constrained dimensions.
Aggregate-risk policy blocks forbidden grant/action combinations.
Future binding exposure is checked against configured budget periods or explicit exception state.
Terminal WorkOrders do not leak unexplained reservations.
Semantic assessment cannot activate structural refinement failure.
High-risk approval cannot commit without evidence satisfying configured independence policy.
System cannot invent HumanRoot successor from timeout alone.
Migration preserves exclusive canonical write authority under durable source fencing.
Migrating Principal cannot be sole continuity verifier.
Principal Layer cannot self-promote outside World 8 Separation of Duties.
No Principal Layer side service becomes a sixth ungoverned canonical plane.
